message.needs_info.subject: {store_name} needs a little more information about your application
message.needs_info.body:
Hello {first_name},

Thank you for applying for a wholesale account with {store_name}. Before we can make a decision, we need a little more information about {company}.

Please update your application using this secure link. It works once and expires in 14 days:
{update_link}
message.rejected.subject: An update on your wholesale application to {store_name}
message.rejected.body:
Hello {first_name},

Thank you for your interest in a wholesale account with {store_name}. After reviewing the application for {company}, we're not able to approve it at this time.

If you have any questions, just reply to this email.
message.renewal_expiring.subject: Your certificate for {store_name} expires on {expiry_date}
message.renewal_expired.subject: Your certificate for {store_name} has expired
message.renewal.subject: {store_name} needs a new copy of your certificate
message.modal.heading: Message for {company}
message.modal.intro: Tradepass doesn't send emails. Copy this message and send it yourself, or open it in your email app. It's written in the recipient's language ({language}).
message.modal.linkNote: The secure link in this message works once and expires. Creating a new link makes this one stop working.
message.modal.subject: Subject
message.modal.copyFailed: The message couldn't be copied. Select the text and copy it yourself.
message.approved.subject: Your wholesale account with {store_name} is approved
message.approved.body:
Hello {first_name},

Good news: {company} has been approved for a wholesale account with {store_name}. Your pricing tier is {tier_name}.

To sign in, open the link below and enter this email address. We'll email you a one-time code, so you don't need a password:
{login_url}

Once you're signed in, you'll see your wholesale prices throughout the store.
